protocols.description: Independent Drinker guide for personal agents: tell it what the user wants to do or know on independentdrinker.com and it answers with where to go on the site. It can't sign in, buy, book or submit forms.

apis.description:
Independent Drinker website search for personal agents, as a read-only 
      MCP server: call search_site with what the user wants to do or know on independentdrinker.com 
      and it returns the matching pages' titles, URLs and short descriptions from the site's own search. 
      It can't sign in, buy, book or submit forms.
